key_result: Over July 1-27, 2026 (17.1 billion messages, 147,113 wallets), markout rankings of wallets persisted across adjacent ten-day windows (Spearman rho 0.52).
takeaway: Reconstructs full order books from a public exchange record that exposes persistent pseudonymous wallet addresses and tests wallet history as a predictive feature.
title: Beyond Anonymous Order Flow: Wallet Identity as a Feature for Short-Horizon Return Prediction
why_it_matters: Most order-book research assumes anonymous order flow; this record makes the account dimension measurable. Accepted at ACM ICAIF 2026.
